title: Tenant checks in attachEvidence/mapAtlasResults are untested: removing the chunk tenant check, the turn tenant check, or the mapAtlasResults tenantId guard leaves chunk-evidence.test.ts green (3 surviving mutants)
reproduction: Mutate each of: chunk.tenantId !== options.tenantId refuse, t.tenantId !== options.tenantId refuse, mapAtlasResults empty-tenant guard -> if(false); run node --test --import tsx src/vector/chunk-evidence.test.ts: all pass. With the mapper guard removed, mapAtlasResults(docs, turns, {}) silently runs unscoped (tenantId undefined skips the check).
fix_direction: Tests where chunk tenant differs but turn matches, turn tenant differs but chunk matches, and mapAtlasResults with {} / tenantId '' must throw. Consider making tenantId required in rankChunksWithEvidence.

title: rankChunksWithEvidence/attachEvidence run unscoped when options.tenantId is omitted (tenantId optional); a foreign-tenant chunk and turn are returned with evidence
fix_direction: Require tenantId in the evidence entry points, matching buildVectorSearchPipeline's no-unscoped-search stance.

title: Provenance check is tautological in the only production path: selectQuote slices the quote out of the same turn text it is then verified against, so deleting the verifyQuoteSpan call leaves all tests green (surviving mutant); also deleting the non-empty/trim check survives
reproduction: Replace 'verifyQuoteSpan(quote, turns.find(...)!)' with 'void 0' in attachEvidence: 10/10 pass. Public verifyQuoteSpan itself is well tested directly (cross-turn, empty, OOB, negative, wrong turnId all throw).
fix_direction: Either accept a caller/persisted quote to verify, or add a test through attachEvidence with an injected faulty selectQuote; add a whitespace-only quote test.

title: Chunk ranker and Atlas adapter are disconnected: not exported from packages/index/src/index.ts, not imported by apps/api semantic-search-store.ts or ask-arms.ts, so no user-visible chunk evidence
reproduction: git grep chunk-evidence|atlas-adapter outside packages/index/src/vector returns nothing.
fix_direction: Export rankChunksWithEvidence from @lkb/index; in createMongoSemanticSearchDeps load turns for chunk turnRefs via scopedCollection<Turns>(tenantId) and call rankChunksWithEvidence(qv, chunks, turnsById, k, {tenantId, queryText: query, skipMismatched:true}); extend SemanticHit with turnIds/tStart/tEnd/quote behind LKB_SEMANTIC_SEARCH. Note the store's find() needs turnRefs and tenantId projected.

title: atlas-adapter.ts contradicts D-021 operationally (no  on self-hosted mongod) and no contract criterion or TASKS row asks for it; also mapAtlasResults does not dedupe duplicate chunk ids or verify score ordering
reproduction: mapAtlasResults with two docs of _id d1 returns 2 rows; unsorted scores keep input order.
fix_direction: Defer/remove until an Atlas deployment decision; file-don't-fix otherwise.

title: Ranker silent on degenerate vectors: empty query vector with empty chunk vectors returns results (score 0); NaN-component chunk vector breaks sort comparator ordering and is refused only if it lands in top k
fix_direction: Refuse empty query vector; refuse non-finite component rows regardless of rank.
